│  faced by the target demographic.                                        │

│  target users.                                                           │
│                                                                          │

│  quizzes, and personalized learning paths.                               │
│    - Integrate gamification elements to encourage regular usage.         │
│                                                                          │
│  #### Phase 4: Testing                                                   │
│  - **Weeks 25-30 (Days 116-147)**                                        │

│    - Analyze feedback, address bugs and issues, refine user experience.  │
│    - Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations.                    │
│                                                                          │

│                                                                          │

│  leaders to promote the app.                                             │
│                                                                          │

│  - **Ongoing**                                                           │
│    - Collect user feedback regularly through in-app surveys and direct   │
│  communication.                                                          │
│    - Track app usage, engagement metrics, and literacy improvement over  │
│  time using analytics tools.                                             │
│    - Assess impact on learning outcomes for participating children.      │
│                                                                          │

│  1. **Project Management:** To oversee the implementation phases         │
│  effectively.                                                            │

│  interface.                                                              │
│  3. **Mobile App Development:** Proficiency in relevant programming      │
│  languages (e.g., Swift, Kotlin) and frameworks/platforms.               │
│  4. **User Research & Testing:** To gather insights from target users    │
│  and validate app features.                                              │
│  5. **Data Privacy Compliance:** Knowledge of data protection            │
│  regulations such as GDPR or CCPA.                                       │
│  6. **Marketing & Outreach Skills:** For promoting the project and       │
│  engaging stakeholders.                                                  │
│                                                                          │
│  ### Timeline                                                            │
│  - **Total Duration:** Approximately 36 weeks (9 months)                 │
│  - **Key Milestones:**                                                   │
│    - Completion of UI/UX design by Week 12                               │
│    - Launch of functional prototype for testing by Week 16               │
│    - Beta Testing completed by Week 30                                   │
│    - Public App Store Release by Week 32                                 │

│  execution.                                                              │
